summary: Repository maintenance: dbus, pkgconf and polkit upgraded with successful validation
changes: Full system repository synchronization and upgrade completed. dbus 1.16.2-1.1 to 1.16.2-2.1; pkgconf 3.0.7-1.1 to 3.0.10-1.1; polkit 127-3.1 to 128-1.1. Restarted only the polkit service to activate its installed executable. The transaction ran standard package hooks. Preserved KDE theme and keyboard configuration, repository configuration, Intel/AMD graphics and gaming packages, and the official ChatGPT package. Preserved the installed newer libclc version. Existing maintenance timer and policy settings were retained. Created private audit records and rollback assets.
tests: Before upgrade: package database and targeted file integrity passed; no failed units; D-Bus GetId and polkit action listing succeeded. After upgrade: package database and targeted file integrity passed with zero altered files; polkit version 128 and pkgconf version 3.0.10 verified; pkgconf metadata queries succeeded. D-Bus GetId, polkit action listing and root authorization query passed after the polkit restart. Its executable is current; D-Bus and display manager retained their original process IDs. No failed units. Protected configuration hashes match. Fresh repository check returned no pending updates. Inventory comparison shows exactly the three intended package updates and no package removal. No application, gaming or performance benchmark was run.
rollback: Retained all three prior signed package archives and a private backup of package metadata and relevant configuration. Recovery can reinstall the three saved prior archives together after dependency review; configuration recovery is selective. Never replace the live package database wholesale. No rollback was required or tested. No reboot was performed.
problem: Routine pending repository updates. During rollback preparation the download user could not access the private audit directory. Several mirrors returned HTTP 404 for prior package versions, but configured fallback mirrors supplied all archives. An initial D-Bus Peer.Ping diagnostic was denied by existing policy; GetId was used successfully. These observations do not establish a distribution defect.
solution: Used the normal package cache without changing sandbox or permissions, then copied verified signed rollback archives into private storage. Completed the reviewed upgrade and activated polkit through a targeted service restart.
reproduction: Not applicable: routine package maintenance; no reproducible distribution defect established.
